title: How can I refine my search from URL query string
body:
How can I refine my search from URL query string, so that whatever color I want to select by default can be selected from URL through query string.

Example : http://\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*/shop/desk-accessories/desk-pads/?refinement=color:black

The above URL should auto select from my selected result for black color.
